title: Exact Newton calculus for tangles with a moving meridian
status: Draft; exact all-level typed moving-meridian calculus and original finite tree contraction, without an analytic or volume conclusion
imports: Complete physical turn/trace calibration, crossing polynomial and circle coefficients from Newton coefficients and positive sources for Conway tangles, Proposition 3.2, equation (4.8) and Section 4. No complete-product theorem is imported.
